title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1973-04-02
lineage: SBD> MR> DAT> SS> CDA> WAV(EAC)> SHN> DAW(Bertha)> CDA/SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a clear mix captures a high‑energy 1973 show highlighted by Brown Eyed Women, Jack Straw, the Weather Report Prelude > Eyes → China Doll sequence and a rare Here Comes Sunshine space jam.
ai_review.review: The performance is described as one of the strongest of the spring ’73 tour, with the band tightly in sync and several standout moments – especially the Eyes/China Doll stretch and the unique HC Sunshine jam. The soundboard source delivers good clarity; reviewers note that the instruments and vocals come through cleanly, though a remastered version is sometimes considered less clear than the original.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both musical performance and sound quality across six detailed reviews; weighted average of strong show (≈4.5) and solid recording (≈4.0) yields a rating around 4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note clear instrument and vocal separation, better sound than alternative source, and overall good mix; some mention the remaster is slightly less clear than the original.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlist praised as outstanding for the year, with smooth transitions and a memorable three‑plus hour arc that ends powerfully with the Eyes/China Doll sequence.

band_member_comments.Phil: Band in sync and Phil’s ‘wall’ sounded good tonight.
